title: Report a bug with Bug Replay
touches: Nothing: you use Aven and tell us what broke
summary: Found something that doesn't work? A bug report with a replay lets anyone watch it happen, which makes it much easier to fix.
why: Bugs that come with an exact replay get fixed first. You don't need to know any code.

steps.text: Play a game until something goes wrong (an error, something that looks broken, or a crash).
Open Window > Bug Replay and press 'Replay the last 20 seconds' to check it happens again the same way.
Press 'Save a bug report'. It makes a folder in bug_reports/ with the replay, pictures and report.md.
On GitHub, open a new issue at github.com/ethandadev/Aven/issues. Paste report.md, and attach filmstrip.png and session.replay (zip the folder if needed).

submit: A GitHub issue is all it takes. Say what you expected to happen and what happened instead.
